body: > Part B may be caused by following code > > @odbozhou I will follow the above questions.

> > Part B may be caused by following code > > > > @odbozhou > > I will follow the above questions. @maixiaohai The retry topic processing methods of pop and push modes are completely different. The retry topic of push is consumed through client subscription. Therefore, SubscriptionData has a retry topic of push. The consumption of retry topic of pop is processed on the server side. There is a certain probability of consumption at the end, so when switching to pop mode, SubscriptionData will not have a retry topic
